---
name: iterate
description: Iterate on a feature or piece of code by improving it, checking for errors, and suggesting next steps.
#model: Gemini 3 Pro (Preview) (copilot)
argument-hint: A description of the feature or code to iterate on.
---

1. Inspect relevant GitHub issues and acceptance criteria for context.
2. Improve the feature or piece of code.
3. If previous steps were suggested, implement them.
4. Check for errors (including linting and tests) and fix them.
5. Reference any related GitHub issue numbers in commits or updates.
6. Suggest next steps tied to the roadmap and open issues.
